title: ProductReliability
description: TOGAF-sourced quality archetype — Reliability viability dimension. Defines the property vocabulary for reliability governance: fault tolerance, circuit breaking, retry policies, bulkhead isolation. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms and as data type for Effectors/Receptors carrying reliability state. Source framework: TOGAF (Technology Architecture resilience patterns) + ISO/IEC 25010 (Reliability sub-characteristic — Maturity, Fault Tolerance, Recoverability).

faultToleranceLevel.description: Fault tolerance classification. NONE = no redundancy. BASIC = restart/retry. HIGH = automated failover. MISSION_CRITICAL = zero-downtime with multi-region redundancy.

circuitBreakerEnabled.description: Whether circuit breaker pattern is required for downstream calls.

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry attempts before failure propagation.

bulkheadEnabled.description: Whether bulkhead isolation pattern is required to prevent cascade failures.
